main: Skip the convenience store! These homemade brown rice tuna rice balls are quick, easy, and only require one bowl for cleanup. Perfect for a satisfying lunch or a grab-and-go snack, they stay soft and delicious even when packed for later.
reply1:
Yields 2 rice balls.

Ingredients:
* 1 instant brown rice pouch
* 1 can tuna (oil squeezed out completely)
* 1 Tbsp mayonnaise
* 0.5 Tbsp soy sauce
* 2 Tbsp seaweed flakes (gim-garu)
* 0.5 Tbsp sesame oil
* Sesame seeds (to taste)
reply2: Warm rice, mix with sesame oil, seeds, and salt. Combine well-drained tuna with mayo and soy sauce. Layer half rice, tuna, then rest of rice on plastic wrap; shape into a ball.
alt_text: Two brown rice tuna rice balls, rolled in seaweed flakes, cut in half to show the tuna mayo filling. A lunchbox container sits beside them. The image is a realistic smartphone food photo under bright natural light.
